findings.finding: Live Codex credits table matches the expected complete input/cached/output rows for Sol/Terra/Luna/GPT-5.5. API list-price archive (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) remains a separate USD table; this item confirms the ChatGPT-credits table used for subscription ratios.

currentValue.claimedAllColumns: input/cached/output all yield ratios Terra×2, Luna×20, GPT-5.5×0.8

findings.finding: Input and cached columns DO follow Terra=Sol/2 (token yield ×2), Luna=Sol/20 (×20), GPT-5.5=Sol×1.25 credits (token yield ×0.8). Output does NOT: Sol 500 vs Terra 300 → yield ≈1.667× not 2×; vs Luna 30 → ≈16.67× not 20×; vs GPT-5.5 750 → ≈0.667× not 0.8×. Same asymmetry appears in API USD archive (Sol out 20 / Terra 12 / Luna 1.2 / GPT-5.5 30). build_adopted.py currently applies the input-only ratio to all tokens; live official credits contradict treating output the same.

findings.finding: Official pricing table has a per-model Usage dollar column that is often below the shared monthly $60 (e.g. Grok/Luna/Pro $15, Flash $30, some models $60). Page explains lower multipliers when discounts are unavailable. So yes: limited models have additional per-model monthly usage caps distinct from the shared $12/$30/$60 base limits.

currentValue.build_adopted.py: 官方表 {req} req/月 × {tok} tok/req (e.g. grok-4.6 845 × (390+32500+120))

findings.finding: Official wording is explicit: request counts are estimates from typical patterns; per-request token mixes are assumptions; actual usage varies. Hard limits are the dollar pools (shared + per-model Usage), not the token/request numbers in the estimate table. Adopted converts estimate req×tok into monthly tokens—consistent with the table arithmetic, but those tokens are not an official hard token ceiling.

findings.quote: 1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE HIT) OFF-PEAK $0.007 / $0.022; PEAK $0.014 / $0.044. 1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE MISS) OFF-PEAK $0.22 / $0.66; PEAK $0.44 / $1.32. 1M OUTPUT TOKENS OFF-PEAK $0.66 / $1.98; PEAK $1.32 / $3.96. (columns: deepseek-v4-flash | deepseek-v4-pro). (1) Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday (all other hours are off-peak).
findings.finding: Live USD table exactly matches archive and adopted metered rows. Official schedule has TWO time tiers (peak / off-peak), each with THREE token-type prices (cache hit, cache miss, output)—not three separate time-of-day tiers. CN page https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/ matches with 元 prices (Flash peak cache-hit 0.10元 / miss 3.0元 / out 9.0元; off-peak half).

findings.quote: Embedded price fields: grok-4.6 cachedPromptTokenPrice=5000, cachedPromptTokenPriceLongContext=10000; grok-4.5 cachedPromptTokenPrice=3000, cachedPromptTokenPriceLongContext=6000; both share promptTextTokenPrice=20000 / completionTextTokenPrice=60000 (and long-context 40000 / 120000). Decoded USD/MTok: 4.6 cache $0.50 / long $1.00; 4.5 cache $0.30 / long $0.60; input $2/$4; output $6/$12.
